title: Bogdan Truța: Writing
subtitle: Writing by Bogdan Truța, AI Engineer at ERNI in Cluj-Napoca, on retrieval, LLM evaluation and agent systems.

posts.title: Claude Opus 5.5 finished Baldur's Gate 3 on its own in 39 hours
posts.description: A half-orc paladin named Claude, 96 sessions, $712 of API usage, a mod, a tool server and nobody at the controls. What the agent saw each turn, where it got stuck, and the one result I had to rerun.
